strategy: Generate I2V only for shots whose motion cannot be delivered reliably with deterministic editorial animation. Use controlled 2.5D motion for dialogue/reaction shots, and reuse the accepted Pilot video for SH006-SH007.

paid_i2v_priority.motion_objective: The phoenix private seal falls and settles, Xiao Ce lifts it with fingertips, then cut to the empress hand and phoenix hairpin match.
Shen Yue drops to both knees while exactly two guards close and secure his shoulders.
Exactly two guards escort Shen Yue toward the doors while his torso keeps moving away and his head turns back; Xiao Ce remains still and calculating.
The imperial edict slides along the stone floor to Shen Yue without lifting; focus rises to Xiao Ce.
Gu Qingshuang aligns the seal-comparison ruler over the two red seals, stops at the missing-claw notch, then lifts her gaze.
The concealed emperor completes one restrained right-hand command gesture; the foreground guard shifts gaze without drawing the saber.
The imperial edict lands and settles on the stone; Xiao Ce's bloodied hand enters but does not touch it.
